0x003D6C.en: 「Come at me from anywhere!/　...wait, I'm the one attacking, huh?」

0x003DE0.en: 「Squaring off, squaring off.../　Ready... and go!」

0x003E64.en: 「Heh heh heh... you ready for this?」

0x003F2C.en: 「I struck first, master./　Let's finish 'em off.」

0x003F82.en: 「Oh my,/　you're more fired up than usual, Gojo.」

0x003FCC.en: 「This one's a bit of a handful.」

0x003FFD.en: 「No matter who it is, Zamzeed can take 'em!」

0x00403D.en: 「Beating strong foes is what a Mazin god's for!」

0x00407A.en: 「I'll show you Zamzeed's true power/　right now!」

0x00413C.en: 「I know. Let's stay sharp and go.」

0x0041AA.en: 「Come on now,/　quit grumbling and get ready to attack.」

0x0041F4.en: 「There's always one like this./　A guy dead sure he's never wrong./　Ugh, the worst.」

0x004278.en: 「Sounds like you've got your reasons.../　but I'll fight! Zamzeed says so!」

0x0042F5.en: 「Since Zamzeed chose me,/　I'm a Mazin god pilot too!/　I'm ready for this!」

0x004376.en: 「I get the gist, and I sympathize.../　but! I still can't just look away!」

0x0043F9.en: 「Secretly-sharp slackers, I don't mind that type.../　but you're different, General Kirkus!」

0x004489.en: 「So you can't afford to hold back,/　General Kirkus./　But you're a sore loser!」

0x004507.en: 「You went too far with a lot of things,/　General Kirkus!/　Too much is as bad as too little!」

0x004597.en: 「Huh? That's Browel, right?/ Why's its Prana value so high?」

0x004605.en: 「Hey, hey! What's with that machine!/　Talk about broken!」

0x004667.en: 「Zamzeed... don't cry!/　I'll take you back!」

0x0046C0.en: 「Don't you get it!?/　Zamzeed is crying!/　Stop being so cruel!」

0x00477C.en: 「How dare you torment Zamzeed!/　I'll punish you, so get ready!」

0x0047F6.en: 「You might not understand, but/　Zamzeed has a heart!」

0x0048B7.en: 「Hm, a decent enough foe./　But so am I!」

0x004910.en: 「Whoa! A surprise tough one!/　Gotta stay sharp here.」

0x00496C.en: 「Hey you! Quit cheating!/　That's flat-out broken!」

0x0049C5.en: 「That guy's just/　a total waste of time, isn't he?」

0x004A21.en: 「Come oooon!/　Let's see how far a big mouth/　can actually get.」

0x004A90.en: 「It's just some computer virus, right?/　Let's clean it up quick.」

0x004AF8.en: 「Yikes, scary just from the face.../　A battle-hardened vet. Better watch out.」

0x004B6C.en: 「How to put it... a real ogre-mug look./　Suits a strict old gym teacher.」

0x004BDD.en: 「You're a Langran Mazin god pilot, right?/　What are you thinking!?」

0x004C4B.en: 「Winner takes all, huh?/　Easy to grasp, but way too shallow!」

0x004CB6.en: 「Only fighting 'cause you're ordered to?/　I get it.../　but I still won't hold back!」

0x004D3D.en: 「I know orders are absolute for soldiers.../　but you're hesitating too, aren't you?」

0x004DA5.en: 「You've got your reasons, sure,/　but if you fight, I show no mercy!」

0x004E07.en: 「You lot are fighting the wrong enemy!」

0x004E41.en: 「You lot are a fox borrowing a tiger's might.../　well, not quite that.」

0x004E9A.en: 「Make me laugh, sure, but/　trying to scare me!?」

0x004EED.en: 「Ah, that's it!/　You ride a dragon or something, right!」

0x004F3A.en: 「Well theeen, let's give it a gooo./　...Dragging it out too long?」

0x004F9C.en: 「With that tone doing the retorts, jokes'd be hard.」

0x005019.en: 「Ugh.../　What vile aura that thing gives off!/　Yeah, can't leave this be.」

0x0050E1.en: 「Let's wrap this up nice and easy,/　master.」

0x00516F.en: 「Hey, Hakkai. Don't slack off too much.」

0x0051A3.en: 「Whoa~/　Look what popped up while I wasn't watching.」

0x00522A.en: 「Ugh! Gross, seriously!/　Let's clean it up fast!」

0x005289.en: 「Gan Eden!/　What you do is unwanted kindness,/　pure meddling!」

0x0052F5.en: 「Whoa~, big bosses galore./　This is the real crunch!」

0x0053AD.en: 「I won't let you do as you please!」

0x0054C7.en: 「I've got no intention/　of letting you off free!」

0x0055A4.en: 「Kyaa!! I, I can't take much more!」

0x005693.en: 「Uwaaah!?/　Ngh... stay calm when you're in a pinch!」

0x0056EC.en: 「Yikes!/　This is no time for jokes anymore~」

0x005803.en: 「Wh-wh-what do we do, master!?/　This is a disaster!」

0x0058A2.en: 「Ahh... this might be the end./　Namu Amida Butsu, Namu Amida Butsu.」

0x00590A.en: 「Th-this is bad.../　Duraxil's a real monster...」

0x00595D.en: 「Uwah!? Bad.../　At this rate, I'm going down!」

0x0059B0.en: 「Overpowering Zamzeed with a Browel.../ what kind of mod is that!」

0x005A18.en: 「Ah, crap.../　You're really something, old man!」

0x005A68.en: 「Augh!! S-so this is the gap in experience?」

0x005AAB.en: 「Guhh!!/　Facing this, I won't last long!」

0x005B04.en: 「No way, seriously?/　Why am I taking this much damage?!」

0x005B5D.en: 「Th-this is bad! I've gotta do something!」

0x005B97.en: 「N-not holding back at all, huh?/　This is rough.」

0x005BE7.en: 「Guh!!/　Y-you came at me for real... quite a pinch.」

0x005C31.en: 「Auugh!! I didn't expect to get pushed back this hard...」

0x005C74.en: 「Gah!!/ Yeah, this guy's the real deal - a total monster!」

0x005D17.en: 「N-not bad!/ But I'm just getting started!」

0x005D64.en: 「Owowow.../ Guess I got a little too cocky?」

0x005DEB.en: 「Agh!!/ Not bad at all, old man...」

0x005E69.en: 「Nice try!/ Zamzeed can take a hundred riders!」

0x005EDB.en: 「Ah, but it looks like/ I'm still doing just fine~」

0x005F22.en: 「Ngh, that's some serious power, I'll give you that.」

0x005F62.en: 「Tch, you live up to the name,/ General Kirkus.」

0x005FAF.en: 「I can't believe a Browel/ has this much power in it...?/ What did you do to it?」

0x00605B.en: 「Ow... just as I thought, you're pretty good.」

0x006098.en: 「Ngh,/ I don't have time to deal with this!」

0x0060E2.en: 「Owow... this is rough,/ and I didn't even let my guard down.」

0x00613B.en: 「Yikes,/ it's not just the face, the attacks are nasty too.」

0x006188.en: 「Whoa!/ A wind type is a bad matchup for me!」

0x006203.en: 「Tch,/ so you won't back down no matter what.」

0x0063B1.en: 「No sweat! Zamzeed's tough and built to last!」

0x0063F4.en: 「Zamzeed won't go down/ from something like this!」

0x006447.en: 「Zamzeed doesn't budge an inch!/ So reliable!」

0x00655A.en: 「Man, Zamzeed sure is/ one tough machine~」

0x0065A7.en: 「Whoa! That's Zamzeed for you./ Even Duraxil won't have it easy!」

0x006615.en: 「Huh, lower attack power than I expected.」

0x006649.en: 「A half-baked mod job/ won't leave a mark on Zamzeed.」

0x0066E2.en: 「What's that?/ You holding back on me?」

0x006720.en: 「Creepy attack, but.../ the power's nothing special.」

0x0067D8.en: 「Bad matchup or not,/ Zamzeed's armor is the best there is!」

0x006893.en: 「What's that? All show and no substance?」

0x006917.en: 「You won't hit me in a million years!」

0x006982.en: 「Can't hit me, just can't hit me♪」

0x006A69.en: 「As expected, master -/　you sure know how to dodge.」

0x006ACF.en: 「Heh, that's my master./ So good at running away.」

0x006B16.en: 「Whoa!/ That'd be real bad if it hit.」

0x006B66.en: 「I see, leading an army/ isn't just for show./ Well, you still can't hit me.」

0x006BE7.en: 「Whoa, fast!/ Guess it's not just a regular Brawler after all.」

0x006D1A.en: 「Forced into fighting,/ your aim's bound to be dull.」

0x006D6A.en: 「All that bulk, but no agility, huh.」

0x006DC9.en: 「Whoa, close one!/ What if that had hit me!」

0x006EC0.en: 「Ugh, I've got no usable weapon here!?」

0x006F5F.en: 「Don't think one round is all it takes!」

0x006F96.en: 「Dawdle and I'll/ slice you clean from behind!」

0x007002.en: 「Wait right there! I'll back you up!」

0x007036.en: 「Not yet! This time I'm going in!」

0x00720B.en: 「Leave it to me! Zamzeed can handle this!」

0x0072D8.en: 「Drop your guard and you'll get burned!」

0x0075CE.en: 「You work folks hard...../ or Familiars, anyway!」

0x0079F2.en: 「A drawn blade like scattering frost,/　back off, back off, or be cut down!!」
